chat.text: I'm trying to decide which Python library to use for a project that involves generating a massive number of PDFs. I've heard both ReportLab and FPDF are popular, but I'm really concerned about the actual rendering performance and speed. In your experience, which one is genuinely faster for high-volume generation? Do you have any specific performance data or benchmarks comparing them?
